# BreathiZen (breathizen.onrender.com)

> breathizen.onrender.com is an independent reader information site about BreathiZen, a daily oral spray sold as a dietary supplement. It is not the manufacturer or seller and does not take orders.

## Product facts (from the seller's published page)
- Form: oral spray, 60 mL (2 fl oz) bottle; serving is 4 sprays (0.60 mL) once daily; about 100 servings per bottle
- Proprietary blend 154 mg: mullein leaf extract 10:1, ginger root extract, organic lemon extract; other ingredients purified water, glycerin, natural flavors, citric acid, potassium sorbate, sodium benzoate
- Made in the USA with globally procured ingredients, in an FDA-registered facility; not for anyone under 18
- Packages: 2 bottles $79 each ($158 plus shipping), 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free US shipping), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free US shipping, free bonuses listed)
- 60-day money-back guarantee; use for at least 30 days, then contact support
- Not a treatment for asthma, COPD or any lung condition and not a substitute for an inhaler or prescribed medicine; ginger may interact with blood thinners, blood sugar and blood pressure medicines
